record.scope: Read-only scratch Node controlled observation; actual unmodified createLibraryUI with its real createPagedList and controlled deferred page responses. Minimal presentation DOM; no browser hit testing or physical-device claim. This is not an additional adopted test or a rerun of CI67.

observations.reason: No browser/layout engine; whether this transition swallowed CI67 click is unknown.

conclusion.actual_product_observation: Changing the search filter clears the paged collection and sets the existing grouping button hidden=true until the query response arrives, even though grouping preference and previously loaded group membership were already known.
conclusion.actual_delegated_click_result: A delivered second delegated click toggles grouping and renders the grouped card synchronously; the response itself does not reset grouped.
conclusion.class_of_risk: The live grouping control transiently disappears during a query request; pointer hit-testing may be affected if the transition falls within a press.

limitations.browser_followup: The original WebKit report contains no pointer target/aria-pressed trace. These deterministic UI/controller regressions prove the transient-control defect and its repair, but real-browser integration still requires the next CI.

event_mechanism_reference.scope: Different down/up targets may dispatch click to a common ancestor. Hidden is not DOM removal. This reference supports the interaction-risk mechanism, not proof of the historical WebKit event sequence.

record.scope: Independent read-only review of the proposed product patch and existing controlled test evidence. No test/browser/load run or source edits by this reviewer.
observations: The product patch changes only grouping control creation/visibility, keeping a display preference in the original collapsed filter panel. It does not alter API parameters, data filtering, cursor binding or page ownership.
The existing owner-change initialization still resets grouped=true; the same grouping preference controls the original groupNotices rendering.
The five tests call the actual ESM createLibraryUI and internal PagedList. Their DOM does not precreate the grouping button: actual insertAdjacentHTML creates it and rejects duplicate insertion.
The controlled 179+1ms boundary uses the original debounce; pending/empty/error/retry and owner/late-response behavior are explicitly asserted.

Original source produced five concrete visibility AssertionErrors; the exact same test bytes produced five passes with the new source. This is distinct from proving the native historical WebKit click trajectory.
limits: No local browser execution or new CI green claimed.
The main67 original timeout remains historical evidence; the controlled visibility bug is proved separately, and native lost-click causation is not uniquely established.
